title: Dihydromyricetin exerts dual anti-acne actions by suppressing propionibacterium acnes proliferation and host inflammatory responses via TLR2/NF-kappaB/MAPK pathway inhibition.
authors: Jin, Liping; Li, Rao; Zhou, Xingchen; Chen, Wangqing; Chen, Xiang; Zhu, Wu
one_liner_zh: 研究黄酮类化合物DMY通过TLR2/NF-kB/MAPK通路抑制痤疮杆菌和炎症，分子对接仅涉及蛋白-小分子，与蛋白质-DNA互作及AI/物理模拟方法无关。
abstract: Acne is a common skin disorder, with Propionibacterium acnes (P. acnes) playing a central role in its pathogenesis. Despite the availability of various treatment options, current therapies are limited by safety concerns and reduced efficacy, highlighting the urgent need for the development of safer and more effective alternatives. This study demonstrated that dihydromyricetin (DMY), a natural flavonoid from Ampelopsis grossedentata, exhibited dual therapeutic actions against acne pathogenesis. DMY exerted potent bactericidal activity against P. acnes with a minimum inhibitory concentration of 0.5 mg/mL and minimum bactericidal concentration of 1 mg/mL, inducing bacterial membrane disruption. In P. acnes-stimulated human keratinocytes, DMY significantly reduced pro-inflammatory cytokine expression (IL-1beta, TNF-alpha, IL-8) and suppressed Toll-like receptor 2 (TLR2) expression. Mechanistically, DMY inhibited phosphorylation of nuclear factor-kappa B (NF-kappaB) p65, c-Jun N-terminal kinase, and p38 mitogen-activated protein kinase (MAPK). In a murine acne model, topical application of 0.1 % DMY gel attenuated ear edema, decreased inflammatory cell infiltration (macrophages, neutrophils, CD4(+) and CD8(+) T cells), and reduced bacterial loads comparable to standard treatments (adapalene and clindamycin). Molecular docking revealed DMY binds TLR2 via hydrogen bonds with TYR-326 and LYS-347 residues. These findings establish DMY as a novel dual-functional agent against acne that simultaneously targets bacterial proliferation and host inflammatory pathways through TLR2/NF-kappaB/MAPK axis modulation.
abstract_zh: 痤疮是一种常见的皮肤疾病，其中痤疮丙酸杆菌（P. acnes）在其发病机制中起核心作用。尽管有多种治疗方案可用，但现有疗法受限于安全性问题和疗效降低，凸显了开发更安全、更有效替代方案的迫切需求。本研究表明，二氢杨梅素（DMY），一种来自藤茶（Ampelopsis grossedentata）的天然黄酮类化合物，对痤疮发病机制表现出双重治疗作用。DMY对P. acnes具有强效杀菌活性，最低抑菌浓度为0.5 mg/mL，最低杀菌浓度为1 mg/mL，诱导细菌膜破坏。在P. acnes刺激的人角质形成细胞中，DMY显著降低促炎细胞因子表达（IL-1beta、TNF-alpha、IL-8），并抑制Toll样受体2（TLR2）表达。机制上，DMY抑制核因子-kappa B（NF-kappaB）p65、c-Jun N末端激酶和p38丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（MAPK）的磷酸化。在小鼠痤疮模型中，局部应用0.1% DMY凝胶减轻耳水肿，减少炎症细胞浸润（巨噬细胞、中性粒细胞、CD4(+)和CD8(+) T细胞），并降低细菌载量，效果与标准治疗（阿达帕林和克林霉素）相当。分子对接显示，DMY通过氢键与TYR-326和LYS-347残基结合TLR2。这些发现确立了DMY作为一种新型双重功能抗痤疮剂，通过TLR2/NF-kappaB/MAPK轴调节同时靶向细菌增殖和宿主炎症通路。
